Verified 2026-10-02 buffer frontend audit: x86 ECX=this plus exactly four DWORD stack arguments (VB, offsetBytes, byteCount, flags), RET 10h. Corrected prototype removes the erroneous 64-bit size_t/high-word flags split. The native VB Lock occurs before entering manager critical section at BYTE offset +80h; lock owner/count writes are +F8h/+FCh. Staging fields are +40h pointer, +44h capacity, +48h original mapping, +4Ch byte count. The existing decompiler critical-section pointer arithmetic uses database type sizing; byte offsets in disassembly are authoritative. Fallout 827BBC20 LockVB is a direct Xenon API wrapper with no corresponding staging or manager lock sequence, so its algorithm must not replace this Oblivion path.

MoonSugarEffect decode: VB lock helper. Locks D3D VB, caches original bytes in a staging buffer, and returns a writable pointer; unlock is handled by packers when they own the lock.

MoonSugarEffect decode: VB lock helper. Locks D3D VB, caches original bytes in a staging buffer, and returns a writable pointer; unlock is handled by packers when they own the lock.
Verified OblivionNew 2026-09-27 for owned VB mapping: helper invokes IDirect3DVertexBuffer9::Lock via vtable+0x2C with caller offset, byte size and flags. It retains the returned pointer at manager+0x48 and byte size at+0x4C, grows CPU staging at+0x40/capacity+0x44, and copies prior mapped bytes to staging unless flags include DISCARD/NOOVERWRITE (mask0x3000). Thus ordinary write locks must expose prior bytes before the packer modifies selected attributes. The caller packers copy staging back and Unlock; e.g. fallback skinned packer0x7774C0 calls this helper0x777662 and VB Unlock0x777A14. Existing decompiler Size/high-word expression conflates 32-bit size/flags; do not infer a 64-bit D3D Lock size.
